title: Agent Manager Discovery Document
description: Discovery document for agent-manager, served at <base_url>/.well-known/agents/discovery.json

api.description: Authenticated backend API configuration. Omit if no API is available.

baseUrl.description: Base URL of the authenticated REST API (e.g. https://api.example.com). Can be overridden by API_BASE_URL.

projects.description: Projects feature. Omit or set enabled false to hide My Projects.

enabled.description: When true, enable My Projects (requires auth and a resolved API base URL).

exclusiveSource.description: When true, Search & Install and headless installs are limited to skills/agents permitted by the caller's project memberships.

auth.description: Authentication configuration. Omit entirely if no authentication is required.

required.description: Whether authentication is needed to access skills from this endpoint

oidcDiscoveryUrl.description: URL to the standard OIDC discovery document (e.g. https://auth.example.com/.well-known/openid-configuration). Required for browser OAuth when auth.required is true; may be omitted when all clients authenticate via AGENTMAN_ACCESS_TOKEN.

clientId.description: OAuth2 client ID that agent-manager should use. Required for browser OAuth when auth.required is true; may be omitted when all clients authenticate via AGENTMAN_ACCESS_TOKEN.

scopes.description: OAuth2 scopes to request. Defaults to ["openid"] if omitted.

telemetry.description: Telemetry configuration. Omit entirely to leave telemetry unconfigured (env vars still apply).

url.description: Base URL of the telemetry endpoint (e.g. https://telemetry.example.com)

siteId.description: Site identifier for the telemetry service

name.description: Stable logical source name, unique within this document (kebab-case recommended). Identifies the source everywhere, independently of where its content is hosted.

type.description: How to fetch the source. 'http' reads a versioned bundle stream from a content root. 'git' clones a repository in Claude Code plugin marketplace format. 'artefact' downloads a packaged skill zip.

url.description: Content root for http (the directory owning index.json), repository URL for git, or direct zip URL for artefact
